title: Norm sections on local finite free affine charts
statement: Let s:Y→X be a finite flat locally finitely presented morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-pc-finite-locally-free], W an open of X, and a a section of O_Y over s⁻¹(W). There is a section g of O_X on W such that every x in W has an affine open neighbourhood B contained in W with the section algebra Γ(Y,s⁻¹(B)) finite free over Γ(X,B), using s.app B for the algebra structure, and the restriction of g to B equals the finite free algebra norm of the restriction of a to s⁻¹(B). No constant rank, surjectivity, or affineness of W is assumed.

proof.text: Apply lem-pc-finite-flat-pushforward-locally-free to the structure sheaf of Y. The resulting pushforward M is finite locally free over X. Use Scheme.Modules.exists_mem_over_iso_free to trivialize M near each point of W and refine the trivializing open intersected with W by the affine-open basis. Scheme.Modules.sectionsLinearEquivOfOverIsoFree identifies its sections on B with a finite power of Γ(X,B), hence Γ(Y,s⁻¹(B)) is free. The algebra structure is definitionally (s.app B).hom.toAlgebra; s.finite_app supplies finiteness. This is the proved private helper exists_free_affine_chart.

For a finite free R-algebra S and an R-algebra A, Algebra.baseChange_lmul and LinearMap.det_baseChange prove norm_A(1⊗a)=algebraMap R A (norm_R(a)) in three rewrites (private norm_tmul_one). For affine C⊆B, restrict the identity pullback square for s to B, s⁻¹(B), C, and s⁻¹(C). Mathlib isIso_pushoutSection_of_isAffineOpen and isIso_pushoutSection_iff give the pushout of section rings. CommRingCat.isPushout_iff_isPushout gives the algebra tensor-product equivalence. Transport the tensor norm by Algebra.norm_eq_of_algEquiv, using equiv_tmul to identify the image of 1⊗a with the restriction of a. This proves private norm_restrict_affine, without assuming that C is principal or that its section algebra has separately been trivialized.

Define the norm of a restricted to each selected chart. Refine every overlap B∩C by affine opens D, whose existence follows from the affine-open basis, without assuming the overlap affine. Apply the affine restriction equality to both B and C on D; functoriality of restriction makes both sides the norm of the same restricted section. TopCat.Sheaf.eq_of_locally_eq' identifies the norms on the overlap. The point-indexed charts cover W. TopCat.Sheaf.existsUnique_gluing' now supplies g with the asserted restrictions, and package each selected chart and its free and finite instances in the conclusion. The empty cover handles empty W, and no argument requires a positive or constant rank.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_finiteLocallyFree_norm_charts
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (s : Y ⟶ X)
    [IsFinite s] [Flat s] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation s]
    (W : X.Opens) (a : Γ(Y, s ⁻¹ᵁ W)) :
    ∃ g : Γ(X, W), ∀ x : X, x ∈ W →
      ∃ (B : X.Opens) (hBW : B ≤ W), x ∈ B ∧ IsAffineOpen B ∧
        (letI := (s.app B).hom.toAlgebra
         Module.Free Γ(X, B) Γ(Y, s ⁻¹ᵁ B) ∧
         Module.Finite Γ(X, B) Γ(Y, s ⁻¹ᵁ B) ∧
         X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hBW).op g =
           Algebra.norm Γ(X, B)
             (Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE (s.preimage_mono hBW)).op a))
